_comment: SHARED ORACLE for the filed-name relation, asserted from BOTH sides:
Every `shown`/`other` pair below is a REAL pair of names off one row of the
SEC June 2026 IA firm roster (ia060126_0.zip) or the EDGAR submissions
index, selected because it renders on a /company/[id] page today. The
`relation` and `jurisdiction_scoped` verdicts are HAND-WRITTEN from the
filings, not generated by either implementation, so agreeing with this file
is evidence and not a tautology. If the two implementations ever disagree,
at least one of them is wrong about a name a reader can look up at
single  only one usable name on the row
same    one entity, two spellings (legal suffix, article, punctuation)
unit    one name extends the other: a named sub-unit of the same firm
other   two different names: treat as two different entities
jurisdiction_scoped: the HIDDEN name scopes the shown one to a territory,
which makes the figure a slice of the group book rather than the group's.
